findings.message: The devolverComMotivo command has a typed field (details.motivoDevolucao) but the definition declares no devolverComMotivo.input state. Added the public devolverComMotivoDraft state (DevolverComMotivoDraft type) with setDevolverComMotivoDraft(value); the id and version are passed as method arguments.

The four commands return resumo and esperaPorMim, which no state declares as source. They are applied to the resumo and esperaPorMim states by replace. avisoDoDia is not returned by the commands and stays as loaded.
public devolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setDevolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
